Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: 1) _principal_axis_angle_deg(mask): PCA on foreground-pixel (x,y) coordinates via np.linalg.eigh of their covariance matrix; angle = atan2 of the dominant eigenvector. 2) Rotate mask with cv2.getRotationMatrix2D(center, angle, 1.0) + cv2.warpAffine (nearest-neighbor) so the lesion's own principal axis is horizontal. 3) _fold_asymmetry(aligned_mask): crop a centroid-centered square window (half-width = max(bbox_h,bbox_w)//2 + 10), then asymmetry = 1 - (IoU(crop, fliplr(crop)) + IoU(crop, flipud(crop))) / 2, where IoU = sum(AND)/sum(OR).
Required_Inputs: Binary instance mask (uint8, 0/255) from YOLO segmentation.
Expected_Value_Range: [0,1] theoretical; observed benign median 0.139, malignant median 0.183 (Evaluation_FeatureEngineering/feature_analysis_table.csv, dev n=2090).
Interpretation_High: More asymmetric shape after alignment to the lesion's own principal axis (poor overlap between mirrored halves).
Interpretation_Low: More symmetric shape (mirrored halves overlap well).
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: HIGHER expected and observed for melanoma. Univariate AUC 0.649 (correct/clinically-expected direction). Standardized logistic coefficient +0.258 (consistent, rank 4 of 17 by |coef|).
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: Legacy concern flag at >0.20 (CONCERN_THRESHOLD, unchanged from original asymmetry.py) — used only for the old concerns/risk_level counter, not read by the V5 logistic model itself.

Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: circularity = (4*pi*Area) / (Perimeter^2 + 1e-6); border_irreg = 1 - circularity. The value stored under the feature name "B_circularity" is actually border_irreg — despite the name, it measures IRREGULARITY, not circularity itself.
Required_Inputs: Binary instance mask; largest external contour via cv2.findContours; cv2.arcLength (perimeter); cv2.contourArea (area).
Expected_Value_Range: Typically (0,~1]; can exceed usual bounds on noisy contours. Observed benign median 0.240, malignant median 0.309.
Interpretation_High: More irregular / less circular border (departs more from a smooth circle).
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: HIGHER expected and univariately observed for melanoma (AUC 0.683 — correct clinical direction). BUT the multivariate standardized coefficient is -0.621 (rank 3 of 17 by |coef|, SIGN FLIPPED vs. univariate). FLAGGED: this is a direction contradiction, most plausibly explained by multicollinearity — B_circularity is a perfect monotonic transform of the excluded isoperimetric_ratio (Spearman rho=1.00, see redundancy_report.md) and is correlated with solidity/turning_angle_std, which are also in the model and compete for the same shape-irregularity signal.
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: Legacy concern flag at >0.50 (unchanged) — feeds the old concerns/risk_level counter only, not the V5 logistic model's probability.

Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: color_cv = std(distances) / (mean(distances) + 1e-6), where distances[i] = Euclidean LAB distance of each lesion pixel (image pixelated to 12x12 blocks first) from a sampled skin baseline LAB color. Skin baseline = median LAB in a ring at 60%-80% of the vignette radius (excluding lesion pixels); falls back to image corners if the ring has <100 clean pixels, or if the ring baseline's L channel <60.
Required_Inputs: Instance mask; no_hair preprocessed BGR image; circle_info (cx,cy,radius) from vignette removal.
Expected_Value_Range: Nonnegative coefficient of variation. Observed benign median 0.342, malignant median 0.395.
Interpretation_High: Greater color variegation relative to the sampled skin baseline (colors within the lesion are more dispersed/inconsistent).
Interpretation_Low: More uniform lesion color relative to skin baseline.
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: HIGHER expected and observed for melanoma. Univariate AUC 0.628; standardized coefficient +0.167 (consistent direction, no flag).
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: Legacy concern flag at CV>0.35 (unchanged). A separate "dangerous color" flag fires per red/blue-gray/white/black fraction >0.08, unchanged, display-only.

Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: D_px = 2 * radius, where radius comes from cv2.minEnclosingCircle() around the largest external contour of the mask.
Expected_Value_Range: Pixels, resolution-dependent, unbounded. Observed benign median 546.8px, malignant median 581.4px.
Interpretation_High: Larger apparent lesion footprint in raw image pixels (confounded by camera distance/zoom and source image resolution — NOT a physical size).
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: HIGHER weakly associated with melanoma. Univariate AUC 0.581 (weak); standardized coefficient +0.143 (weak, rank 11, consistent direction).
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: D_mm is ALWAYS None — no pixel-to-mm calibration is trusted for this dataset (module docstring: an investigation found 0/40 images had a hair-shaped majority in the dark-blob detector, so hair-based calibration never fires). The unused 10.0mm legacy concern threshold (DIAMETER_CONCERN_MM) therefore never activates. No normalization applied to D_px itself (see D_px_normalized for the normalized variant).

Function_Or_Section: run_single_image_inference() [YOLO/Ultralytics per-instance detection confidence, passed through in revised_abcd/pipeline_v2.py::process_image]
Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: Raw Ultralytics YOLO segmentation-instance confidence score for the selected (highest-confidence / primary) detected instance.
Required_Inputs: YOLO model inference output on the raw image.
Expected_Value_Range: [0.25, 1.0] in practice (inference is called with conf=0.25 floor). Observed benign median 0.8312, malignant median 0.8154.
Interpretation_High: Segmentation model is more confident the detected region is a lesion (mask likely more trustworthy).
Interpretation_Low: Weaker detection confidence (mask more likely to be inaccurate/partial).
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: Essentially NO signal / near-chance. Univariate AUC 0.470 (slightly BELOW 0.5 — benign has a marginally higher median). Standardized coefficient -0.059 (smallest-magnitude, rank 15 of 17). Included as a segmentation-quality covariate, not a discriminative ABCD signal.
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: None — used only as a raw numeric feature; separately, values <0.5 trigger a display-only "low_confidence" quality flag in segmentation_quality_flags_v2 (does not affect the ML score).

Required_Inputs: lesion_fraction = mean(mask > 0), i.e. fraction of the ENTIRE image frame's pixels covered by the lesion mask (not a crop-relative fraction).
Expected_Value_Range: Instance mask, same dimensions as the full image.
Interpretation_High: [0,1]. Observed benign median 0.047, malignant median 0.273 — very large gap.
Interpretation_Low: Lesion occupies a large portion of the photo frame (either a genuinely larger lesion, or a photo taken more zoomed-in/close).
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: Lesion occupies a small portion of the frame.
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: HIGHER strongly associated with melanoma. Univariate AUC 0.757 (2nd-strongest of all 17 features). Standardized coefficient +0.062 (small — much of its raw predictive weight is shared with/absorbed by D_px_normalized, see next row). CRITICAL CONCERN: Spearman rho=0.989 with D_px_normalized (confirmed in Evaluation_FeatureEngineering/redundancy_report.md) — the two features are nearly duplicates and both plausibly reflect photo framing/zoom convention rather than true lesion size, which the original researchers flagged as "the single most important redundancy finding."
column12: None; also feeds legacy display-only flags (fragmented mask if >1 meaningful component >20px; "large_area_fraction" note if >0.5).

Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: 2D histogram (16x16 bins, range 0-255 each) of the LAB a/b channel values over lesion-mask pixels of the no_hair image (OpenCV's unsigned 8-bit LAB encoding, a/b in [0,255], not signed). Shannon entropy = -sum(p * log2(p)) over nonzero bins, p = normalized histogram counts.
Expected_Value_Range: [0, log2(256)=8] bits, bounded by bin count (log2(256 bins)=8 max). Observed benign median 1.296, malignant median 1.574.
Interpretation_High: More distinct a/b color combinations present in the lesion (more heterogeneous color palette).
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: HIGHER associated with melanoma. Univariate AUC 0.650; standardized coefficient +0.149 (consistent).
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: Requires >=20 in-mask pixels or returns NaN. Fixed 16x16 histogram binning; no other normalization.

Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: Standard deviation of the LAB "a" channel (green-red axis) over lesion-mask pixels of the no_hair image.
Expected_Value_Range: Nonnegative, LAB-channel units. Observed benign median 3.20, malignant median 3.88.
Interpretation_High: Wider spread of green-red hue values within the lesion.
Interpretation_Low: More uniform green-red hue within the lesion.
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: HIGHER associated with melanoma. Univariate AUC 0.655; standardized coefficient +0.230 (consistent, rank 7).
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: Requires >=20 in-mask pixels or NaN. No other normalization.

Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: Standard deviation of the LAB "b" channel (blue-yellow axis) over lesion-mask pixels of the no_hair image.
Expected_Value_Range: Nonnegative, LAB-channel units. Observed benign median 4.68, malignant median 5.63.
Interpretation_High: Wider spread of blue-yellow hue values within the lesion.
Interpretation_Low: More uniform blue-yellow hue within the lesion.
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: HIGHER associated with melanoma. Univariate AUC 0.645; standardized coefficient +0.243 (consistent, rank 6).
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: Requires >=20 in-mask pixels or NaN. No other normalization.

Function_Or_Section: score_color() [pink_red_pixels return value, UNCHANGED, wired into the 17-feature set via pipeline_v5/feature_extraction.py::extract_v5_new_features]
Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: Fraction of lesion pixels (4x4-block pixelated image) satisfying (A_channel > skin_A+10) AND (L_channel > skin_L-30), i.e. redder-than-skin and not-too-dark, relative to the same sampled skin baseline C_value uses.
Expected_Value_Range: [0,1], but observed values are extremely skewed toward 0. Observed benign median 0.0, malignant median 0.0004 (both medians effectively zero).
Interpretation_High: A larger share of lesion pixels read as pink/red relative to skin baseline.
Interpretation_Low: Almost no pixels read as pink/red (the common case for both classes).
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: HIGHER associated with melanoma. Univariate AUC 0.625 despite both class medians being ~0 — this AUC is being driven by a minority of cases with materially nonzero values, not a broadly shifted distribution. Standardized coefficient +0.157 (consistent, rank 9). FLAG: sparse/skewed feature — its discrimination may be concentrated in a small number of high-value cases rather than reflecting a stable population-level signal; worth checking case-by-case in visual review.
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: Same 0.08 legacy display-only "dangerous color" threshold as C_value; not used by the V5 logistic model.

Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: max(blue_gray_abs, 0.15 if blue_gray_rel else 0.0), where blue_gray_abs = fraction of pixels with (L < skin_L-60) AND (B < skin_B-15); blue_gray_rel is a boolean whole-lesion condition (10th-percentile L and B channels both well below the lesion's own median) contributing a flat 0.15 floor when true.
Expected_Value_Range: [0,1] but effectively bimodal near {0, 0.15, higher}. Observed benign median 0.0, malignant median 0.0 (identical).
Interpretation_Low: No detected blue-gray coloring (the common case for both classes).
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: Essentially NO discrimination between classes at the median. Univariate AUC 0.558 (near chance); standardized coefficient +0.004 (smallest-magnitude of all 17 features, rank 17/17). FLAG: potentially weak/near-uninformative feature — both class medians are identical (0.0).
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: Same 0.08 legacy display-only threshold; the internal 0.15 floor is a hard-coded step-function value, not tuned/validated separately.

Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: max(black_abs, 0.12 if black_rel else 0.0), where black_abs = fraction of pixels with L < skin_L-130; black_rel is a boolean condition (10th-percentile L well below lesion median) contributing a flat 0.12 floor when true.
Interpretation_High: Larger very-dark/black region detected within the lesion.
Interpretation_Low: No detected black regions (the common case for both classes).
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: Weak discrimination. Univariate AUC 0.541 (near chance); standardized coefficient +0.028 (rank 16/17, near-smallest). FLAG: both class medians identical (0.0); similar concern profile to bluegray_fraction.
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: Same 0.08 legacy display-only threshold; internal 0.12 floor is a hard-coded constant.

Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: Euclidean LAB-space distance between the mean LAB color inside the lesion mask and the mean LAB color in a thin ring immediately surrounding it. Ring = dilate(mask, ellipse kernel of radius r=max(5, 0.05*sqrt(area))) minus mask.
Expected_Value_Range: Nonnegative LAB-distance units. Observed benign median 42.96, malignant median 37.36 — LOWER for melanoma.
Interpretation_High: Lesion color contrasts strongly with its immediately surrounding skin.
Interpretation_Low: Lesion blends more smoothly into its immediately surrounding skin.
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: LOWER associated with melanoma in this dataset (Cohen's d -0.189, univariate AUC 0.429, i.e. below chance if read as "higher=more concerning"). Standardized coefficient -0.246 (rank 5 of 17, meaningfully negative) — consistent with the (counter-intuitive) univariate direction. FLAG FOR HUMAN REVIEW: this contradicts a naive clinical prior that melanoma should contrast MORE with surrounding skin; could reflect that many malignant lesions in this dataset are larger/more diffuse at the border (pushing the sampling ring further from any sharp edge) or could be a genuine signal — cannot be resolved from code alone.
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: Requires >=20 ring pixels or NaN (~0.05% missingness in dev set, one degenerate case).

Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: solidity = contour_area / convex_hull_area, via cv2.convexHull() and cv2.contourArea() on the largest external contour.
Expected_Value_Range: (0,1], typically close to 1. Observed benign median 0.963, malignant median 0.938 — lower for melanoma.
Interpretation_High: Boundary closely matches its own convex hull (smooth, few notches/projections).
Interpretation_Low: Boundary departs from its convex hull (concave notches, irregular projections).
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: LOWER associated with melanoma — this is the clinically expected direction (irregular border = lower solidity = more concerning). Univariate AUC 0.334 (i.e. |AUC-0.5|=0.166 in the correct direction once sign is accounted for). Standardized coefficient -0.728 — the LARGEST-magnitude coefficient in the model, correctly signed, consistent with both univariate evidence and clinical expectation. No contradiction; the model's single most influential feature.
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: None applied beyond the ratio itself.

Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: Resample the largest contour to 100 equally arc-length-spaced points; compute the discrete turning angle (change in tangent direction between consecutive resampled points, wrapped to [-pi,pi]) around the closed contour; return the standard deviation of these turning angles.
Expected_Value_Range: Radians, nonnegative std. Observed benign median 0.2405, malignant median 0.3231.
Interpretation_High: Boundary has more local wiggliness/notching after fixed-point resampling (smooths out raw per-pixel rasterization noise, unlike using cv2's native point list directly).
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: HIGHER associated with melanoma. Univariate AUC 0.719 (3rd-strongest of all 17 features). Standardized coefficient +0.094 (correct direction, but a much smaller multivariate weight than its univariate strength suggests — likely because solidity and B_circularity are absorbing overlapping border-irregularity signal).
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: Requires contour with >=8 points (else NaN). Resampling to a fixed 100 points is itself a de-noising / normalization step.

Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: geometry_v5_features() [via cv2.fitEllipse, or cv2.minAreaRect fallback if <5 contour points]
Required_Inputs: eccentricity = sqrt(1 - (minor_axis/major_axis)^2), from the best-fit ellipse's major/minor axes.
Interpretation_High: [0,1). Observed benign median 0.685, malignant median 0.688 — essentially identical.
Interpretation_Low: Lesion's overall outline is more elongated (cigar/oval-shaped).
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: Lesion's overall outline is closer to circular.
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: ESSENTIALLY NO STANDALONE SIGNAL. Univariate AUC 0.503 — chance level. Standardized coefficient -0.100 (rank 12 of 17) — the model still assigns it a non-trivial weight despite zero marginal signal, almost certainly picked up via correlation with other geometry features (aspect_ratio, rho=1.00, excluded; radial_cv, rho=0.913, excluded) rather than carrying independent information. FLAGGED as a potentially weak/redundant feature.
column12: None applied beyond the ratio itself.

Exact_Formula_Or_Algorithm: D_px_normalized = D_px / sqrt(image_height * image_width) — the existing D_px feature divided by the geometric mean of the image's pixel dimensions, to make raw pixel diameter comparable across images of different resolution.
Expected_Value_Range: Dimensionless ratio. Observed benign median 0.315, malignant median 0.755 — the LARGEST effect size of all 17 features (Cohen's d 0.976).
Interpretation_High: Lesion diameter spans a large fraction of the image's linear scale.
Interpretation_Low: Lesion diameter is a small fraction of the image's linear scale.
Direction_Associated_With_Melanoma: HIGHER strongly associated with melanoma — highest univariate AUC of all 17 features (0.758). Standardized coefficient +0.720, the 2nd-largest-magnitude coefficient, correctly signed. CRITICAL CONCERN (same as lesion_fraction, above): Spearman rho=0.989 with lesion_fraction — nearly a duplicate feature. The original ablation researchers explicitly documented this as the study's single most important redundancy finding, and flagged it as "expected to add little" precisely because it likely reflects photo framing/zoom convention (how close/cropped the source photo is) rather than a physical lesion-size signal distinct from what lesion_fraction already captures. Whether this apparent "diameter" signal is a real ABCD-D effect or a dataset-framing confound cannot be resolved from code alone and needs human/clinical review of the underlying images.
Thresholds_Or_Normalization: No physical (mm) calibration; purely a scale-normalization of D_px by image dimensions.
